      135→
      136→        use_enum_values = True
      137→        extra = "forbid"
      138→
      139→    def _process_multivalue_field(
      140→        self,
      141→        field_name: str,
      142→        field_value: List,
      143→        custom_delimiters: X12Delimiters = None,
      144→    ) -> str:
      145→        """
      146→        Converts a X12 multi-value (list) field into a a single delimited string.
      147→
      148→        A "multi-value" field is a field which contains sub-fields, or components, or allows repeats.
      149→        The X12 specification uses separate delimiters for component and repeating fields.
      150→
      151→        By default the method will use default X12 delimiters. Custom delimiters may be specified if desired using
      152→        the `custom_delimiters` parameter.
      153→
      154→        :param field_name: The field name used to lookup field metadata.
      155→        :param field_value: The field's list values
      156→        :param custom_delimiters: Used when custom delimiters are required. Defaults to None.
      157→        """
      158→
      159→        delimiters = custom_delimiters or X12Delimiters()
      160→        is_component_field: bool = self.__fields__[field_name].field_info.extra.get(
      161→            "is_component", False
      162→        )
      163→        if is_component_field:
      164→            join_character = delimiters.component_separator
      165→        else:
      166→            join_character = delimiters.repetition_separator
      167→        return join_character.join(field_value)
      168→
      169→    def x12(self, custom_delimiters: X12Delimiters = None) -> str:
      170→        """
      171→        Generates a X12 formatted string for the segment.
      172→        By default, the method will use default X12 delimiters. Custom delimiters may be specified if desired using
      173→        the `custom_delimiters` parameter.
      174→
      175→        :param custom_delimiters: Used when custom delimiters are required. Defaults to None.
      176→        :return: the X12 representation of the model instance
      177→        """
      178→
      179→        delimiters = custom_delimiters or X12Delimiters()
      180→        x12_values = []
      181→        for k, v in self.dict(exclude={"delimiters"}).items():
      182→            if isinstance(v, str):
      183→                x12_values.append(v)
      184→            elif isinstance(v, list):
      185→                x12_values.append(
      186→                    self._process_multivalue_field(k, v, custom_delimiters=delimiters)
      187→                )
      188→            elif isinstance(v, datetime.datetime):
      189→                x12_values.append(v.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M"))
      190→            elif isinstance(v, datetime.date):
      191→                x12_values.append(v.strftime("%Y%m%d"))
      192→            elif isinstance(v, datetime.time):
      193→                x12_values.append(v.strftime("%H%M"))
      194→            elif isinstance(v, Decimal):
      195→                # Decimal keeps the scale it was parsed with, so "2" stays "2"
      196→                # and "545.00" stays "545.00". "f" avoids scientific notation.
      197→                x12_values.append(format(v, "f"))
      198→            elif v is None:
      199→                x12_values.append("")
      200→            else:
      201→                x12_values.append(str(v))
      202→
      203→        x12_str = delimiters.element_separator.join(x12_values).rstrip(
      204→            delimiters.element_separator
      205→        )
      206→        return x12_str + delimiters.segment_terminator
      207→
      208→
      209→class X12SegmentGroup(abc.ABC, BaseModel):
      210→    """
      211→    Abstract base class for a container, typically a loop or transaction, which groups x12 segments.
      212→    """
      213→
      214→    @root_validator(pre=True)
      215→    def _wrap_single_repeatable_segments(cls, values):
      216→        """
      217→        Accepts a single segment record where the model declares a list.
      218→
      219→        The parser stores the first occurrence of a segment as a dict and only
      220→        appends when the loop initializer pre-seeded a list. If an initializer
      221→        misses a repeatable segment, the model would otherwise reject a bare
      222→        dict for a ``List[...]`` field. Wrapping it here keeps a missed
      223→        pre-seed from being a validation failure.
      224→
      225→        Pydantic v2 port: this becomes ``@model_validator(mode="before")`` and
      226→        the field shape check uses ``get_origin(field.annotation) is list``.
      227→        """
      228→        if not isinstance(values, dict):
      229→            return values
      230→        for name, field in cls.__fields__.items():
      231→            if field.shape != SHAPE_LIST:
      232→                continue
      233→            value = values.get(name)
      234→            if isinstance(value, dict):
      235→                values[name] = [value]
      236→        return values
      237→
      238→    def x12(
      239→        self, use_new_lines: bool = True, custom_delimiters: X12Delimiters = None
      240→    ) -> str:
      241→        """
      242→        Generates a X12 formatted string for the segment.
      243→
      244→        By default the method will use default X12 delimiters. Custom delimiters may be specified if desired using
      245→        the `custom_delimiters` parameter.
      246→
      247→        :param use_new_lines: Indicates if the X12 output includes newline characters. Defaults to True.
      248→        :param custom_delimiters: Used when custom delimiters are required. Defaults to None.
      249→        :return: Generates a X12 representation of the loop using its segments.
      250→        """
      251→        delimiters = custom_delimiters or X12Delimiters()
      252→        x12_segments: List[str] = []
      253→        fields = [f for f in self.__fields__.values() if hasattr(f.type_, "x12")]
      254→
      255→        for f in fields:
      256→            field_instance = getattr(self, f.name)
      257→
      258→            if field_instance is None:
      259→                continue
      260→            elif isinstance(field_instance, list):
      261→                for item in field_instance:
      262→                    if isinstance(item, X12Segment):
      263→                        x12_segments.append(item.x12(custom_delimiters=delimiters))
      264→                    else:
      265→                        x12_segments.append(
      266→                            item.x12(
      267→                                use_new_lines=use_new_lines,
      268→                                custom_delimiters=delimiters,
      269→                            )
      270→                        )
      271→            else:
      272→                if isinstance(field_instance, X12Segment):
      273→                    x12_segments.append(
      274→                        field_instance.x12(custom_delimiters=delimiters)
      275→                    )
      276→                else:
      277→                    x12_segments.append(
      278→                        field_instance.x12(
      279→                            use_new_lines=use_new_lines, custom_delimiters=delimiters
      280→                        )
      281→                    )
      282→
      283→        join_char: str = "\n" if use_new_lines else ""
      284→        return join_char.join(x12_segments)
